variables.name: GIT_SSH_COMMAND
variables.description: SSH command used when pushing/fetching over SSH

variables.name: GIT_DIR
variables.description: Path to the .git directory; overrides auto-detection

variables.name: GIT_EDITOR
variables.description: Editor for commit messages, rebase instructions, etc.

globalOptions.name: help
globalOptions.summary: Print synopsis and a list of the most commonly used commands

globalOptions.name: C
globalOptions.summary: Run as if git was started in the given path

globalOptions.name: no-pager
globalOptions.summary: Do not pipe git output into a pager

parameters.name: message
parameters.summary: Use the given message as the commit message

parameters.name: all
parameters.summary: Stage all tracked modified and deleted files before committing

parameters.name: amend
parameters.summary: Amend the tip of the current branch

parameters.name: dry-run
parameters.summary: Show what would be committed without actually committing

commands.name: push
commands.summary: Update remote refs along with associated objects

parameters.name: remote
parameters.summary: Remote name (default: origin)

parameters.name: refspec
parameters.summary: Branch or refspec to push

parameters.name: force
parameters.summary: Force the push (potentially destructive)

parameters.name: force-with-lease
parameters.summary: Force push only if remote ref matches expected value

parameters.name: dry-run
parameters.summary: Show what would be pushed without actually pushing

parameters.name: set-upstream
parameters.summary: Set the upstream tracking reference

commands.name: pull
commands.summary: Fetch from and integrate with another repository or local branch

parameters.name: remote
parameters.summary: Remote to pull from

parameters.name: rebase
parameters.summary: Rebase instead of merge

parameters.name: no-commit
parameters.summary: Perform merge but do not autocommit

commands.name: clone
commands.summary: Clone a repository into a new directory

parameters.name: repository
parameters.summary: Repository URL or path to clone

parameters.name: directory
parameters.summary: Local directory name

parameters.name: depth
parameters.summary: Create a shallow clone with a history truncated to this number of commits

parameters.name: branch
parameters.summary: Checkout this branch instead of HEAD

parameters.name: recurse-submodules
parameters.summary: Initialize and clone submodules

commands.name: reset
commands.summary: Reset current HEAD to the specified state

parameters.name: commit
parameters.summary: Commit to reset to (default: HEAD)

parameters.name: hard
parameters.summary: Discard all changes in working tree and index

parameters.name: soft
parameters.summary: Keep working tree and index; only reset HEAD

parameters.name: mixed
parameters.summary: Keep working tree; reset index (default)

parameters.name: oneline
parameters.summary: Shorthand for --format=oneline --abbrev-commit

parameters.name: graph
parameters.summary: Draw a text-based graphical representation

parameters.name: n
parameters.summary: Limit the number of commits to output

parameters.name: format
parameters.summary: Output format (oneline, short, medium, full, fuller, email, raw, or a format string)
